about.coreTeamAjelexRole: Umushingwabikorwa wa node (Ishami ryigenga mubuhinga bwa none)
about.coreTeamContent: Plan ₿ Network ni ihuriro rigizwe n’isinzi ry’abantu batanga intererano, abigisha, imboneza z'imirwi y'ikibano, abacafyi bokubuhinga bwa none, abateza imbere ubuhinga bwa none, hamwe n'abahuza bikorwa. Turashimira ivyumwihariko abantu benshi batumye Plan ₿ ibaho kandi babandanya kubikora uko bukeye n’uko bwije.(Urutonde rw’abatanze intererano ruzoshirwa ahabona vuba)
about.coreTeamRogzyRole: Uwutunganya ibicuruzwa akaba n’umwe mu bayishinze
about.corporateContent: Plan ₿ Network ni ihwaniro ry'imigambi ugizwe n'amashirahamwe atatu yibanda kw'iterambere rya Bitcoin. Mu ntumbero yo kwagura inyigisho zijanye na Bitcoin no kuzishikana kure hashoboka, ayo mashirahamwe yaciye afata ingingo yo gukorana, maze hashingwa Plan ₿ Network. Kuva icogihe, ayandi mashirahamwe menshi yahisemwo guterera hamwe nogushira inguvu hamwe kugira ngo adufashe gushikana inyigisho za Bitcoin kw’isi yose. Kubera iyo mvo, tubashimiye bivuye ku mutima.
about.description: Plan ₿ Network ifasha imigwi yikibano itandukanye kw’isi yose kwisuganya neza kugira ngo itange inyigisho nziza. Runo rubuga rurateza imbere ibikoresho bikenewe kugira ngo hashikweko intego, biciye muri kaminuza yokubuhinga ngurukana bumenyi, kurubuga rw’inyigisho, igikoresho c’inyigisho ku bijanye na Bitcoin, hamwe n’ahantu hatororokanirizwa inyandiko z’inkenerwa.
about.manifesto:
Turizera kazoza k'ubwigenge Bitcoin itanga biciye mu buryo budakwirikiranwa n’uruhande rumwe (decentralized).

Intumbero yacu ni ukumenyekanisha Bitcoin ku bantu bagera kuri miliyaridi imwe mu myaka icumi. Ibikoresho dukoresha ni inyigisho n’amakuru.  

Duherekeza kandi dushigikira imigwi y’ikibano ya Bitcoin bo mu mihingo itandukanye, tubaha inyigisho ziguruye (open-source) hamwe gushira kumugaragaro umuryango w'abahanuzwajambo ba Bitcoin.

Filozofiya yacu yisunze "Cypherpunk Manifesto". Nk’uko bo baharanira ubuzima bw’ibanga, natwe turaharanira inyigisho. Ariko, twemera ko ubumenyi ari ryo shingiro y'ubwigenge n'impinduka.

Turi Bitcoin gusa.  

Turaharanira ko umuntu afata inshingano ku giti ciwe, kandi ko ukwikukira gushikwako mu gutunga imfunguruzo zawe bwite.  

Turahamagarira gusuzuma, aho kwizigira atacobifatiyeko.  

Twemera ko mu gukosora amafaranga, twoshobora gukosora isi.

Turi abadafise aho batwarirwa, kandi dukoresha ivyiyumviro vyuguruye (open-source), twirinda ko ikintu kimwe coshobora gutuma ibintu bipfa.  

Turashigikira itangwa ry’ivyigwa vyacu ku buntu no ku buryo bworoshe.  

Duharanira isi itunganywa kuva hasi gushika hejuru, aho umuntu ku giti ciwe arihagati.

Turagabanya, turigisha, turasangiza.  

Nimwifatanye natwe mu ntumbero yo gushikiriza isi yose akamaro ka Bitcoin!
about.missionContent1: Intumbero yacu ni ugushigikira imigwi y’ikibano ya Bitcoin, biciye mu nyigisho zishingiye ku buryo bwa "open-source" no mu kubahuza. Mu kubishikako, turatororokanya, tugatunganya kandi tugakora ibikoresho bikenewe (Ivyigwa, ibitabu, ibipapuro vy’inyigisho,udupapuro tw'inyigisho, n’amareresi) kugira ngo uruganda rwa Bitcoin rushobore gutera imbere.
about.missionContent2: Turakoraniriza ubumenyi ahantu hamwe kugira tubushobore gusangiza abandi mu buryo bworoshe kandi bubereye, dukoresheje ububiko bwa GitHub bworoshe kandi burimwo indimi nyinshi, hamwe n’urubuga rw’inyigisho rukoresheje ikoranabuhanga (E-learning). Turafasha kandi ibigo vya Bitcoin vyo mu turere mu rugendo rw’iterambere ryavyo, tubaha ibikoresho bikwiye kugira ngo impano zaho zibafashe gutera imbere.
about.storyContent: Plan ₿ Network ni umugambi ushigikira inyigisho zijanye na Bitcoin kw’isi yose. Ni ihwaniro ry’amashirahamwe atandukanye akora ibikorwa vya Bitcoin, yibanda ku nyigisho, porogarame za open-source, uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru hagati y’abantu babiri (peer-to-peer), no kwubaka ubumwe mu migwi. Turihamwe, Ayo mashirahamwe yiyemeje gukorera hamwe kugira yubake Plan ₿ Network, maze batange ibikoresho bikwiye vyofasha Umuryango wagutse wa Bitcoin kugirango ukure . Icegeranyo c’ivyo twashize ahabona mu 2023 kiraboneka ngaha.
about.title: Ivyerekeye Plan ₿ Network

details.attendInPersonWarning: Niwaba uteganya kwitaba rino shure mukibanza rizoberamwo, nube uracunguura ikibanza cawe hakiri kare. Ariko rero, icigwa kizoba ikibiriraho kuri ngurukana bumenyi kandi uzoshobora kurisubiramwo igihe cose wipfuza.
details.collaborativeEffort:
Ibirimwo vyose ku rubuga ni ivyavuye mu bikorwa vy’ubufatanye: icigwa cose, ugusigura, hamwe no gusubiramwo bikorwa biciye mu ruhare rw’abafasha batandukanye. Kubera iyo mpamvu, tuguma turondera burigihe abashobora gusuzuma no kugenzura inyandiko zacu mu ndimi nyinshi. Nimba wifuza kwifatanya muri iyo mirimo yo gusuzuma, turakwinginze uje mumuryango wacu wa <0>Telegram</0> usome kandi <1>inyigisho ngufi</1> zacu.

Tuributsa ko zinonyandiko zishobora kubonwa n'uwariwe wese (open-source) — bigengwa na <2>CC BY-SA</2> — bivuga ko bishobora gusangirwa no gukoreshwa ku buntu, igihe gusa habonetse ugushira iteka aho vyaturutse.

Tugusabe usuzume neza icigwa insiguro z'inyigisho zatanzwe.
Buricirwa cose gitangwa mu buryo bw'ikibiriraho aho vyabereye ku matariki n’ahantu vyateguwe. Amashure yose aca kandi atwarwa ku buhinga bwo kubisangiza abantu ku murongo no gufatwa amajwi n’amashusho kugira bishobore kwerekanwa ukundi.

careerPortal.description: Nk’umunyeshuri wa Plan ₿ Network, uri mu muryango mugari ushobora kugufasha gukura mu kazi kawe. Muri iki gice, urashobora kurungika CV(Umwidondoro) yawe no gusangiza abandi imigambi yawe y’akazi. Tuzokorana n’abafatanyabikorwa bacu bo mu ruganda kugira ngo umwidondoro wawe uhuze n’akazi gashoboka, tukagufasha gutera intambwe ikurikira mu rugendo rwawe rw’umwuga.

courses.announcementsIntroduction:
Uretse amatangazo y’ukwiyandikisha kuvyigwa atangwa na sisiteme, ufise kandi uburyo bwo kwandika no gutegura ayandi matangazo y’inyongera ku banyeshure bawe. Urugero, ushobora kubamenyesha ibihindutse mu bijanye n’ukwitegura canke amakuru y’akanya gato.
Abanyeshure bazoronka ayo matangazo kuri sisiteme, kandi no ku butumwa bwa email (nimba bahisemwo iyi ngingo yiyongerako).
